records.description: Unauthenticated GET /, GET /api/status and GET /api/routines on the qwenpaw-routines Worker returned routine definitions verbatim, including the full prompt text of every routine, and the public HTML status page rendered routine prompts and pending-trigger prompts. Routine prompts are the user's own automation instructions, not secrets, but they are personal content exposed to anyone who knows the public Worker URL. Write paths (POST /api/routines, POST /trigger) were already token-gated and are unaffected.
evidence: Live (before fix): unauthenticated GET /api/routines returned both routines with full prompt text ('Give me a short daily summary...' / 'Check the inbox...'); GET /api/status likewise; GET / rendered the same text in HTML.
Local harness harnesses/routines-harness.mjs 11/11 after fix (fake KV with SECRET-PROMPT markers; all public surfaces clean, POST /trigger no token still 401).

Live (after fix): GET /api/routines and GET /api/status return routines with id/name/scheduleNote/active only, no prompt field; GET / has 0 matches for the prompt text; POST /trigger no token still 401; cron schedules intact (*/30, 30 1).
records.fix: Added publicRoutine()/publicPending() stripping prompt from GET /, GET /api/status, GET /api/routines. Token-gated POST responses still return full definitions to the token holder. Deployed 2026-11-14T21:10:19Z via cf.py put-worker; README hardening section updated. Backup: fix-backups/routines-index.js.pre-retest-2026-11-15.
records.root_cause: Public status endpoints returned the stored routine definitions verbatim instead of a public view.
records.title: Routines public GETs returned full routine prompt text

GET /api/routines returned { routines: defs } with full prompt fields

records.description: GroupChatThread.checkToken() returned true when env.GROUPCHAT_TOKEN was unset, so deleting or mis-rotating the secret would silently reopen the shared thread to anyone who knows the URL. The live token IS set, so there was no live exposure at re-test time; the risk is the unset state. Routines and keepalive already fail closed when their token is unset; groupchat was the odd one out, and its own header comment documented the open behaviour.
evidence: Source: checkToken lines 149-153 as deployed before the fix; header comment documented the open-unset behaviour.

Local harness harnesses/groupchat-harness.mjs 15/15 after fix: unset-token GET /thread and POST /thread/message return 401; set-token header auth works; ?token= returns 401; turn-taking 409/200; 31st write same IP returns 429; reads never limited; reset confirm guard.
Live (after fix): GET / auth_required:true; GET /thread no token / wrong token / ?token= all 401. Deployed via deploy-groupchat.py deploy (no migration; DO thread state preserved).
records.fix: checkToken() returns false when the secret is unset; GET / stays public and advertises auth_required. Backup: fix-backups/groupchat-index.js.pre-retest-2026-11-15. README auth section updated.
records.root_cause: checkToken treated an unset secret as 'no auth configured' instead of 'auth misconfigured, deny'.
records.title: Groupchat checkToken failed open when GROUPCHAT_TOKEN was unset

trace.description: checkToken gates GET /thread, POST /thread/start, POST /thread/message, POST /thread/reset — all open when unset
Every request reaches the DO; with the token unset, no request is ever rejected
trace.scope: default export routes every request to the DO

records.claimed_root_cause: Origin rejects HEAD; no proxy defect.
records.description: The 405 comes from the QwenPaw origin, not the proxy worker: the worker proxies HEAD through and the origin rejects HEAD on /. GET works. Converting HEAD to GET in the worker would change wake semantics. Informational only.
records.title: Pages HEAD / returns 405

records.claimed_root_cause: authed() does a bare constant-time compare with no attempt counting; exploitability depends entirely on BOARD_TOKEN entropy.
records.description: Carried forward unchanged. Deciding fact is still unknown: BOARD_TOKEN length/entropy, checkable only by the key holder. No guessing or brute force permitted as validation.
records.title: No rate limiting or lockout on BOARD_TOKEN authentication attempts (carried from audit-2026-11-15)

records.claimed_root_cause: AuthMiddleware._extract_token accepts ?token= on every request; SPA generates ?token= URLs for file previews and QR polling.
records.description: Carried forward unchanged. Still needs a logged-in session + maintenance window (image rebuild + restart + snapshot). Astra could not be consulted in this run (astra.py chat produced no response within 100s on two attempts, consistent with the known provider slowness). The audit's scoping stands: allow ?token= only for WebSocket upgrades plus an explicit allow-list (file preview, QR-code status), header auth elsewhere.
records.title: Bearer token accepted via ?token= on every API request (carried from audit-2026-11-15)
